# InVet Command: final-gate

Equivalent to OpenCode `/final-gate`.

Input: `BE-00X`, `FE-00X`, or `QA-00X`.

Use agent: `InVet Final Reviewer`.

Before acting, read:

- `.opencode/commands/final-gate.md`
- `.opencode/agents/invet-final-reviewer.md`
- `docs/opencode/templates/review_findings_template.md`
- `docs/opencode/14_github_copilot_agentic_flow.md`

Run the optional release review after QA, reviews, checks, and docs are complete.
